name: pegasus
_about: The PEGASUS (2026-11-07): the horse (mammals/horse.json: its frame, rig, shapes and coats) with a pair of great feathered wings rooted at the withers -- built with the birds' own wing builder (flier.wing, as the eagle's: a covert-shingled arm, secondaries along the trailing edge, fingered primaries); its tip about 3.2 m out from the spine, a span of about 6.4 m, raised 33 degrees. The wing is drawn SPREAD, as it glides; on the ground it is folded along the flank (skeleton.js PERCH: an.perch 1, its fit an.perchFold -- skysteeds.js SKYSTEEDS.pegasus), and the game takes it up: a gallop, a climb on hard beats, wide circles gliding with bursts of beats, and down again to a meadow (skysteeds.js). White, as the myth has it; the coats a dapple grey, a black and a palomino, each with wings to match (`wing`, `wingTip`, `primTip`, `covert`, `wingIn`): the feathers a cooler, silvered grey-white against the warm grey-white hair, greying toward the tips, the primaries' tips darkest. (2026-11-08, ears2.py) The EARS (ears2.py): long LEAVES (sharp.js `fin`), narrow at the root and pointed, cupped forward; the roots faired.
_coats: COATS (species.js coatDef): white (its own), dapple grey, black, palomino -- the horse's own colour tables (mammals/horse.json), white's the unicorn's, each with its wings: `wing` the flight feathers, `wingTip` the secondaries' tips, `primTip` the primaries', `covert` the coverts over them and the arm, `wingIn` the under coverts

sculpt._about: the horse's shapes (mammals/horse.json, at 2026-11-07) and a flier.wing (wlib/skywing.py) on the withers: peg.py
